name: Goldplay Mining Inc.
summary: Goldplay Mining Inc. engages in exploring and advancing gold, silver, and copper projects. Its projects include the Scottie West gold project covering 6,358.8 hectares located to the northwest of Stewart, British Columbia; and Portugal copper gold projects. The company was formerly known as Industria Metals Inc. and changed its name to Goldplay Mining Inc. in November 2020. Goldplay Mining Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
